key_insight: TGZM is a maskless batch furnace step that makes junction-isolated through-silicon conductors before FEOL, removing DRIE, liner, seed, plating and CMP from signal vias.
killer_doubt: Al solubility caps doping near 2e19 cm-3: a 10x60 um column is ~34 Ohm vs 0.04 Ohm Cu, so ~20 A stack power still needs Cu TSVs; C ~150-500 fF.
decisive_experiment: Migrate 10,000 10 um Al dots 60 um into n-Si at 1100 C on a 150 mm wafer; thin, then map column yield, lateral wander, resistance, and junction C and leakage at 85 C. ~$150k.
prior_art: GE Anthony and Cline TGZM (1970s) for thyristor isolation; doped-silicon via columns in MEMS such as Silex Sil-Via (prior knowledge).

key_insight: Decode reads every weight once per token, a perfectly sequential pattern rotating media serve natively; ~300 MB/s per head at HDD-class linear density is realistic.
killer_doubt: ~1,000 heads plus read channels per 2.5 GB drum: at ~0.3 W each that is ~125 pJ/bit (HBM 3-4), and >$40/GB even at $0.10 per channel.
decisive_experiment: Spin stand with an 8-32 channel fixed head array over a glass platter: measure per-channel BER, track keeping without actuators over +/-5 K (~0.3 um/K drift at r=40 mm), and watts per channel. ~$300k.
prior_art: IBM 650 and Univac head-per-track drums; parallel-head disk drives (1980s); Seagate MACH.2 dual actuators; Apple LLM-in-a-Flash streaming (prior knowledge).

key_insight: Pinning moves stored electrons off Si/SiO2 interfaces: median dark current ~1e-18 A (~6 e-/s) vs a 13 fA tail, with transistor-channel writes, so endurance is unlimited.
killer_doubt: Duplicate of I-00973 (R03, HOLD). Planar pinned wells hold ~6,000 e-/um2: 1,000 e- plus 3-4T is ~0.1-0.2 um2, >100x a 0.00086 um2 6F2 cell, not 4-8x.
decisive_experiment: None separate: settled by the I-00973 CIS MPW test (pinned wells 0.1-0.5 um wide, electrical fill-and-spill write, 25 ns CDS read, dark-current tails at 25-85 C).
prior_art: Global-shutter CIS storage nodes; Fossum QIS jots; Phase B N-84 Jot-RAM; R03 reviews of I-00973 and I-06032.

key_insight: A storage node that only gates a varactor has no read current path, so reads add zero leakage or disturb; qubit-style dispersive readout is real aF-sensitive physics.
killer_doubt: A minimum varactor swings ~5-10 aF on a ~50 fF line (1e-4 shift); with Q~10 and ~0.3 mV kTC noise, reads need ~1 us; each resonator ~20 nH.
decisive_experiment: Paper and SPICE first: SNR of a 16-512 cell varactor line at 300 K for 20 ns reads; only if SNR>10, a 28 nm MPW row with a shared resonator. ~$50-250k.
prior_art: Gate-based dispersive readout of spin qubits (Colless 2013, Gonzalez-Zalba 2015) (prior knowledge); 2T/3T gain cells already read non-destructively, no restore.

key_insight: Activations recomputable from layer outputs double as free redundancy: overlap between stored and reconstructed tiles detects SRAM upsets without ECC bits, possibly allowing lower-Vmin SRAM.
killer_doubt: RevNets already deliver the 2-10x memory cut; the new ECC-free check saves only ~12.5% SECDED bits and needs bit-exact fixed-point reversal costing ~25-30% compute.
decisive_experiment: PyTorch study: BDIA-style exact-reversible ViT and GPT-2 with injected SRAM bit flips at 1e-6 to 1e-3; measure detection coverage, accuracy and compute overhead versus SECDED. ~$20k GPU time.
prior_art: RevNet (Gomez 2017); Reformer; BDIA exact-reversible transformer (arXiv 2407.09093, R34 log); ABFT for DNNs (prior knowledge).

key_insight: Reservation padding, not physical use, strands cluster DRAM; making OOM a checkpoint-migrate event lets schedulers pack near-median requests, raising usable memory 1.3-2x with no new bits.
killer_doubt: Median requests mean ~half of jobs exceed them; a 64 GB CRIU dump and restore takes ~25-30 s at 5 GB/s NVMe, and GPU or socket state often breaks migration.
decisive_experiment: Replay Google 2019 Borg and Alibaba traces in a scheduler simulator with P50/P80/P95 requests and measured CRIU costs; then a 20-node Kubernetes pilot with cuda-checkpoint. ~$100k.
prior_art: Google Autopilot (2020) limit raising; Meta TMO; Azure Pond stranding study; Kubernetes container checkpointing KEP-2008; DMTCP (prior knowledge).

key_insight: Bit-plane layout lets a fetch stop once a partial value decides ReLU sign or top-k rank, so bandwidth tracks decision difficulty, not nominal precision.
killer_doubt: Decisions occur on dot-product outputs, so weight planes are read for every input; realistic savings ~1.3-2x on ReLU-sparse layers, ~0 on SwiGLU; tiers add nothing over row layout.
decisive_experiment: Trace-driven DRAM simulation of MSB-first bit-plane fetch with interval bounds on Llama-class decode (weights and keys); report bytes read per token versus INT8. ~$20k.
prior_art: SnaPEA (ISCA 2018) early negative detection; Stripes and Bit-Pragmatic bit-serial; Any-Precision LLM bit-plane weight layout (ICML 2024) (prior knowledge).

key_insight: Retention spec, not physics, sets capacitor height: at a 13 fA tail, 0.5 fF holds 0.2 V ~8 ms, so an AR~8 ONO capacitor in a 30 nm hole suffices.
killer_doubt: Full-die 1 ms refresh is ~2e9 row cycles/s per 16 Gb die (~290% of per-bank tRC time, ~0.6-2 W); KV cache lives seconds, so few bytes may qualify.
decisive_experiment: Instrument byte-lifetime histograms (alloc/free, page touch) for LLM serving, training, Spark and Redis; compute the share of resident bytes living under 1 and 10 ms and the resulting refresh energy. ~$50k.
prior_art: IBM and Intel eDRAM with ~40-100 us retention; Flikker and RAPID refresh-aware placement; R12 I-05411 (DROP); Phase B N-64 lease refresh.

key_insight: Defining a memory cell by electrical windows, not substrate, could let depreciated non-semiconductor coating capacity qualify for capacity-tier bits; the PDK itself is cheap to write.
killer_doubt: Coil, foil and PV lines pattern at >=10-50 um; even Gen-8.5 display rules (~2 um) give ~100 um2/bit, ~0.9 m2 of glass per GB (~$50/GB) and microsecond access.
decisive_experiment: Cost and performance model plus one display-fab IGZO 2T1C test array: cell area, retention and access time at Gen-6 rules versus DDR5 at $1.48/GB. ~$150k.
prior_art: Display-fab CAAC-IGZO memory work (SEL, Sharp); printed and flexible TFT memory research (prior knowledge).

key_insight: In series the less-leaky device sets hold current, so a cell fails only if both write devices are bad: tail p becomes ~p^2 (1e-5 to 1e-10), plus ~10x stack-effect cut.
killer_doubt: p^2 needs independent defects; hydrogen clusters or grains in a shared vertical channel correlate them, and Si storage-node junction/GIDL leakage (much of the 13 fA tail) is not stacked.
decisive_experiment: Fab 1 Mb IGZO or 28 nm Si gain-cell arrays with one versus two series write gates (vertical double wordline, same footprint); map retention to 1e-6 at 85 C and test tail correlation. ~$300-500k.
prior_art: 4T gain cell with series write and retention transistors plus feedback, US10002660 (via search snippet); stack-effect leakage reduction is textbook.

key_insight: Sub-percolation metal islands raise effective permittivity using abundant Al, Ti and O: a Hf- and Zr-free route toward k~70 if leakage could be tamed.
killer_doubt: A 5-6 nm DRAM film holds only 2-3 islands across; ~8x k enhancement concentrates field ~8x in sub-nm gaps (2 to ~16 MV/cm), past breakdown, and islands trap charge.
decisive_experiment: ALD MIM coupons: Al2O3 with 0-30% TiN sub-monolayer cycles, 5-8 nm thick; measure C-f to 1 GHz, leakage at 1 V and 85 C, and 1e12 bipolar cycles. ~$80k.
prior_art: Bulk percolation composites (Efros-Shklovskii); metal nanocrystals in Al2O3 for charge-trap flash; nanoparticle-embedded MIM capacitors (prior knowledge).

key_insight: Margin-gated fallback is the right shape: spend exact-weight bandwidth only on low-confidence tokens, keeping ~3-bit resident weights for ~5x less weight DRAM.
killer_doubt: One projection r^T(W-Wq)x bounds a scalar of one layer; error compounds through ~80 nonlinear layers, so a valid logit certificate needs FP16 hidden states, making fallback ~100%.
decisive_experiment: On an 8B model, measure greedy-token mismatch of 3-bit versus FP16 against final-logit margin, and test whether any per-layer projection statistic predicts mismatch at <5% fallback. ~$10k GPU.
prior_art: Speculative decoding (Leviathan 2023) gives exact match with quantized drafts; Apple LLM-in-a-Flash; Freivalds check (1977) (prior knowledge).
